## Overview

We return to data wrangling with a focus on reshaping data using tidyr. This week also introduces the data project — the main assessment for the course. We look at how to import, clean, and restructure real-world datasets ready for analysis.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Download

Download the project for this week, unzip it, and double-click `06-content.Rproj` to open it in RStudio: [06-content.zip](/files/projects/06-content.zip)
